title: Nova Lingua plan artifact
description: A PLAN as a commons artifact (spec/world-state.md): the {assume, steps} that `nl-validator check-plan` decides, made content-addressed (plan_…) so a checked plan is fetchable, re-decidable, and citable by address. Unsigned — a plan's soundness is recomputable from the referenced records' declared world contracts, never testimony. Step arguments are value expressions; the checker validates them semantically (arity against the target's body, groundability of world keys), so they are constrained only structurally here.

hash.description: BLAKE3-256 content address over the JCS-canonical artifact with `hash` stripped.

assume.description: What the planner is willing to assume about the initial world — testimony, priced as such (and spot-verifiable by observation probes: `check-plan --probe`).

key.description: Ground literal key parts only — an assumption names a concrete resource; a `var` names nothing here.

target.description: The function record this step applies, by content address.

args.description: Concrete value expressions, positional — the checker holds arity to the target's body.
